name: VEX V5 Speed Tank (6-wheel)
description: Fast VEX V5 competition drive on six 3.25 in wheels: 4 x 11 W Smart Motors with blue (600 rpm) cartridges geared 36:48 (450 rpm at the wheel), the middle wheels chained to the motored ones. Omni wheels on the corners and traction wheels in the middle are the usual mix; the spec records one wheel size. The drive uses 44 W: the 2026-27 V5RC rules (Override manual R11) cap drivetrain motors at 55 W and all motors at 88 W, so the older 6 x 11 W drive (66 W) is no longer legal. Motor numbers are VEX's published ratings; mass and size are typical values, not measurements of one robot.
